text: Currently using this app to write this review. The transcription is very good, no doubt about that, but the keyboard it utilises is just unbelievably awful. It replaces your entire keyboard with one button! Now, technically, you can use a keyboard, but then you have to switch over to it, which is just completely unintuitive and feels bizarre. The keyboard itself isn't very good either. They need to focus less on the AI side and more on the normal interface side.
